g.title: CPP_QSP
g.text: Central Precocious Puberty (CPP) — Mechanistic QSP Map
KNDy Pulse Generator Disinhibition (MKRN3/DLK1 loss) → GnRH Pulse FREQUENCY ↑ → LH/FSH → Gonadal Steroids
THE CENTRAL TENSION: oestradiol enters the adult-height integral TWICE WITH OPPOSITE SIGNS
(+) raises growth velocity via GH/IGF-1 amplification (−) consumes growth-plate proliferative reserve → epiphyseal fusion
Therapy: GnRH agonist depots/implant (pulsatility destroyed, NOT axis ablated) · GnRH antagonist · aromatase inhibitors · rhGH add-on · anti-oestrogens for GnRH-INDEPENDENT disease

g.title: cluster_genetic
g.text: 1. Genetic / Epigenetic Set-Point — puberty is RESTRAINED, and CPP is usually a lost brake

g.title: cluster_environment
g.text: 2. Metabolic & Environmental Gating — permissive, not causal

g.title: cluster_kndy
g.text: 3. KNDy Pulse Generator (arcuate nucleus) — the oscillator whose OUTPUT IS A FREQUENCY

g.title: cluster_gnrh
g.text: 4. GnRH Neuron → Median Eminence → Portal Delivery

g.title: cluster_pituitary
g.text: 5. Pituitary Gonadotrope — receptor occupancy vs PULSATILITY DECODING (the site of GnRHa action)

g.title: cluster_testis
g.text: 7. Testis (boys ~10% of CPP; ~40-75% have an organic CNS cause)

g.title: cluster_adrenal
g.text: 8. Adrenarche — an INDEPENDENT axis: pubic hair progresses ON therapy (a counselling trap)

g.title: cluster_peripheral
g.text: 9. GnRH-INDEPENDENT (Peripheral) Precocious Puberty — where a GnRH agonist is STRUCTURALLY USELESS

g.title: cluster_gh
g.text: 10. GH–IGF-1 Axis — sex steroids AMPLIFY it (this is the (+) term in the height integral)

g.title: cluster_plate
g.text: 11. Epiphyseal Growth Plate — SENESCENCE IS A CONSUMED RESERVE, NOT A TIME (the (−) term; irreversible)

g.title: cluster_bone
g.text: 12. Bone Mass Accrual — GnRHa withdraws E2 DURING the peak-accrual window

g.title: cluster_target
g.text: 13. Secondary Sexual Development — the examined phenotype

g.title: cluster_pk_gnrha
g.text: 14. GnRH-Analogue PK — the clinically decisive axis is TROUGH COVERAGE, not potency

g.title: cluster_pk_other
g.text: 15. Other Pharmacology — antagonists, aromatase inhibitors, rhGH, anti-oestrogens, anti-androgens

g.title: cluster_cns
g.text: 16. CNS, Behaviour & Psychosocial — the reason to treat when height is not at stake

g.title: cluster_longterm
g.text: 20. Life-Course Outcomes (drivers of the decision to treat at all)

g.title: GnRH_deg
g.text: → why native GnRH is useless as a drug

g.title: Senescence
g.text: spent by divisions, not clock time)

g.title: Interdose_escape
g.text: the failure mode of monthly depots

g.title: PCOS_later
g.text: by treatment (~ same as untreated CPP)
